ui_bugs.issue: FIXED — TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'nama'). After saving edit, onSaved() sets person=null while the Dialog is still animating out; render used person.nama causing runtime error overlay. Patched to person?.nama ?? f.nama.

action_items: None blocking. Verify the applied null-guard fix in HrdDokumen.jsx PersonDialog looks acceptable.
critical_code_review_comments: hrd_people.py list_people search regex uses raw user input q — safe against Mongo injection because it's coerced to string regex, but consider escaping regex special chars (., *, +, ?) to avoid ReDoS / unintended matches from user input.

Letter counter key is per-year only ('letter_{code}_{year}') but nomor embeds month — two letters in different months of same year share seq counter, which is intentional but worth confirming the desired schema (spec says '/{year}/{month}/{seq}').

delete_person soft-deletes the employee but its docs and issued letters remain queryable/verifiable — consider cascading soft-delete or at least indicating on the letter verify response that the source employee was removed.

PDF response Content-Disposition uses filename with hyphens replacing slashes but does not URL-encode non-ASCII characters in employee names — some browsers may mangle filenames like `Muhammad_Ãli.pdf`.
Upload dir /app/backend/uploads/employees is on ephemeral container disk; will be lost on redeploy — should use persistent volume or object storage (S3/GCS).

rca of the issue: PersonDialog: when user saved an edited karyawan, parent set edit=null immediately. Radix Dialog stays mounted during close animation, but the DialogTitle referenced person.nama unconditionally, and inner state f still had f.id truthy → threw TypeError. Fix: use optional chaining + fallback to f.nama for the header title. No other similar unguarded refs to person.* in that component (all other reads go through the local state f).
